about.dataStored: Data is stored in a secure cloud database, tied to your account.
about.feature.autosave.desc: Everything is saved as you type. Julian Date is computed in real time from UT.
about.feature.autosave.title: Auto-save & JD
about.feature.catalog.desc: Fully editable catalog with VSNET / AAVSO designations, comparison-star charts and types (VISUAL, BINAR, ...)
about.feature.catalog.title: Star catalog
about.feature.exports.desc: Two separate .txt files in correct formats. Only entries with a filled UT time are exported.
about.feature.exports.title: VSNET / AAVSO exports
about.feature.favorite.desc: Mark one session as a template — it's protected from deletion and can be used to spawn new ones.
about.feature.favorite.title: Favorite session
about.feature.graphs.desc: Light curves for individual stars across all sessions, including markers for "fainter-than" estimates.
about.feature.graphs.title: Observation graphs
about.feature.json.desc: Back up your catalog and individual sessions as JSON and restore or transfer anywhere.
about.feature.json.title: JSON export & import
about.feature.language.desc: Language switcher in the header — choice persists between sessions.
about.feature.language.title: Slovak / English
about.feature.method.desc: Magnitude is computed automatically: mag = A + (steps A / (steps A + steps B)) · (B − A). Limits (<14.9) are supported.
about.feature.method.title: Nijland-Blazhko method
about.feature.nav.desc: Quick jumps between region on the sky.
about.feature.nav.title: Navigation by sky region. By default, the catalog is organized by constellation names. However, each region may also include objects belonging to neighboring constellations. Users can create their own custom regions. The BINAR and VISUAL regions contain objects grouped according to the type of observation.
about.feature.ocr.desc: Photograph a hand-written paper log and AI transcribes it into the table. Free 5/day, Plus 15/day.
about.feature.ocr.title: AI OCR scanning
about.feature.plus.desc: Free plan (200 MB) or Plus at €2/month — default constellation, 800 MB storage and 15 AI scans/day.
about.feature.plus.title: Plus plan
about.feature.pozor.desc: Altitude plot for the Moon and targets from the catalogue through the night with eclipsing-binary minima times markers, an observability journal, and other useful information.
about.feature.pozor.title: Pozor — Observation planner
about.feature.prom.desc: Lookup table converting letters to magnitudes for comparison stars, with letter labels on the chart.
about.feature.prom.title: Comparisons - Catalogue of comparison stars
about.feature.sessions.desc: Create a new session in one click — empty, a copy of the last, or from your favorite (with cleared UT times).
about.feature.sessions.title: Observing sessions
about.feature.tools.desc: A SIPS → VSNET/AAVSO converter and a two-way Julian Date ↔ date converter.
about.feature.tools.title: Tools
about.languageDesc: In the header on the right, click the SK / EN button to switch between Slovak and English. Your choice will be saved locally in the browser.
about.ocrDesc: Automatic recognition of handwritten tables using AI — take a photo of your paper record, and the app will automatically fill in stars, A/Passed/B values, and UT times. In the Plus plan, 40 scans per month are allowed, while the Free plan allows 5 scans per month.
about.plan.free: Almost all features · 200 MB storage · 5 AI scans / day.
about.plan.manage: Manage your subscription in Settings → Plan & billing.
about.plan.plus: Default region · 800 MB storage · 15 AI scans / day · multiple Pozor catalogs · minima prediction.
about.pozorDesc: A dedicated module observing plans: an altitude chart for the Moon and targets above the horizon marking twilight times and eclipsing-binary minima, an observability journal, minima predictions, and your own named catalogs independent of the visual catalog.
about.settingsDesc: In Settings, set your observer code (default DPV). In the Catalogue, you can add, remove, and move stars between constellations.
about.subtitle: The form for visual estimates of variable stars' brightness using the Nijland-Blazhko method with exports to VSNET, and AAVSO.
about.title: Visual Astro — Visual Observation Log
